about: What each role sees first: the order of the main navigation, the order of the tabs inside an area, and the work the home page lists. Nothing here grants or hides access; the API decides that. A link left out of a list keeps its usual place after the listed ones. "landing" sends a main navigation link to another page of its area for a role.

deal_team.does: Source deals, run diligence, and follow the positions you lead.

work.label: Pipeline
work.what: Move deals through the stages, the diligence tasks and the gates

work.label: Monitoring board
work.what: See which quarterly reports are in, read and approved for your positions

work.label: Valuations
work.what: Review the marks operations prepared, and approve them or send them back

work.label: Change requests
work.what: Ask for a correction to a deal's record and follow it until it is applied

work.label: Sponsors
work.what: Funds, positions and commitments by sponsor

work.label: Value creation
work.what: Where the gain on each position came from

operations.does: Keep the record: capital activity, valuations, documents, closings and data intake.

work.label: Capital notices
work.what: Review calls and distributions and draft the trade tickets

work.label: Wire register
work.what: Propose wire instructions and make the callbacks

work.label: Valuation board
work.what: Draft and prepare the quarter's marks

work.label: Change requests
work.what: Start, apply or reject the corrections the deal team asked for

work.label: Document review queue
work.what: Decide the tags the classifier was not sure of

work.label: Extraction
work.what: Review the figures read from sponsor reports before they reach the record

work.label: Intake
work.what: Stage the accounting export and approve the validated rows

work.label: Exceptions
work.what: Work the data exceptions that are open

approver.does: Give the second signature: valuations, trade tickets, changed wire instructions and committee decisions.

work.label: Valuation board
work.what: Approve the reviewed marks and lock the quarter

work.label: Trade tickets
work.what: Approve a release that someone else prepared

work.label: Pipeline
work.what: Take deals to the investment committee and record the decision

work.label: Wire register
work.what: Verify a changed instruction by callback

work.label: Analytics
work.what: Exposure, performance and realizations across the portfolio

investor_relations.does: Report to the clients you are entitled to.

work.label: Clients
work.what: Each client's look-through across the vehicles it is in

work.label: Weekly report
work.what: The week's figures, movers and capital activity

work.label: Disclosures
work.what: The approved wording that goes with client figures

work.label: Client analytics
work.what: Exposure and performance by client

work.label: Portfolio
work.what: The positions behind your clients' vehicles

auditor.does: Read the record and the trail of who changed what. Nothing can be changed from this role.

work.label: Audit trail
work.what: Every change to a figure: who, when, the old value and the new

work.label: Access and walls
work.what: Who holds which role and who is behind an information wall

work.label: Valuations
work.what: Versions, approvals and locks for every mark

work.label: Wire register
work.what: Each instruction, its callback and who verified it

work.label: Data health
work.what: Orphans, open exceptions and stale positions

platform_admin.does: Run the platform: feature flags, access, integrations and reference data. This role does not read deal workflows.

work.label: Flags
work.what: Switch a feature or an assistant on or off, with a reason

work.label: Access and walls
work.what: Roles, client entitlements and information walls

work.label: Integration health
work.what: The state of each adapter and its last check

work.label: Data dictionary
work.what: Field definitions and display rules

work.label: Taxonomy
work.what: The terms every list and filter uses

viewer.does: Read the portfolio you are entitled to see. Nothing can be changed from this role.

work.label: Portfolio
work.what: Every position with invested capital, NAV, MOIC and IRR

work.label: Analytics
work.what: Exposure, performance, the credit book and realizations

work.label: Weekly report
work.what: The week's figures, movers and capital activity

work.label: Sponsors
work.what: Funds, positions and commitments by sponsor
